description:
The thinking family's one implementation of the ThinkingPhase
        SPI: the deep-research RetrievalPhase, plus the two-phase
        machinery (TwoPhaseThinkingExecutor) it builds on. A thinking
        key activates a retrieval pass that searches and crawls through
        the hosted web tools declared for it, streams its narration as
        the response's reasoning events, and injects its consolidated
        findings as a trailing conversation pair the answering pass
        cites; the machinery keeps the original request byte-identical
        across both passes (a KV-cache shared prefix) and exposes the
        phase-1 tools posture and the injection wording as protected
        seams. Pure implementation only — bean registration lives in
        the franca-spring-thinking-retrieval registration jar.
